description: This file defines an Admin interface component for a React application. It provides functionalities for admin users to upload datasets in XLSX or TXT format, parse them deterministically into structured payloads related to roles, competencies, role competencies, and adjacencies, compare with existing database state, and seed new data into a Supabase backend via an edge function. It includes utilities for parsing files, diffing datasets, and verifying admin access.

methods.name: normalizeKey
methods.description: Normalizes header keys by trimming, converting to lowercase, and replacing whitespace with underscores.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads a file and returns its content as ArrayBuffer (for XLSX files) or text (for TXT files).

methods.name: parseXlsx
methods.description: Parses an XLSX buffer into structured payload sections: roles, competencies, role competencies, and adjacencies based on heuristics.

methods.name: parseTxtRoleCard
methods.description: Parses a plain text role card to extract role information such as code, name, and description.

methods.name: mergePayloads
methods.description: Merges multiple partial payloads into a single deduplicated, deterministic payload.

methods.name: fetchSnapshot
methods.description: Fetches current database state for roles, competencies, role competencies, and adjacencies for diff calculation.

methods.name: computeDiff
methods.description: Calculates the difference in counts of new entries vs existing database snapshot for each entity type.

methods.name: checkIsAdmin
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has admin privileges based on database table 'admin_users'.
